'''Guck''' are resources dropped by [[Abomination|Abominations]] and [[Gucksack]]s in the [[Swamp]] biome. Gucksacks are not damaged by ranged attacks and must be mined with an axe or pickaxe. Players must build elevated platforms or ladders to reach the Gucksacks.

Guck can be used to refuel [[Standing Green-burning Iron Torch]]es.

{{infobox item | title = Flax | image = Flax.png | description = Unspun fibers from a flax plant. | id = Flax | type = Material | source = [[Fuling Village]] in the [[Plains]] biome.
[[Abandoned Village]] [[Barrel]]s. | usage = Building, Crafting, Farming, Taming | weight = 0.2 | stack = 100 | teleport = Yes | crop = 2 Flax | grow time = {{duration|4000}}-{{duration|5000}} | cultivated = Yes | radius = 0.5 | biomes = [[Plains]] }} '''Flax''' is a material that can be found in [[Fuling Village]]s within the [[Plains]] biome, as a small patch of cultivated land or in chests, as well as in the [[Barrel]]s inside the [[Abandoned Village]]s in the [[Deep North]]. It is more common to find [[Barley]] in cultivated spots in the [[Fuling Village]]s , so it may be necessary to search multiple villages. Flax can only be re-grown within the [[Plains]] biome, and is done by replanting it with a [[Cultivator]]. It takes between 4,000 seconds and 5,000 seconds (between 66 minutes 40 seconds and 83 minutes 20 seconds, or about 2.22-2.78 in-game days) for it to fully grow. It is recommended to replant some in a safe space as soon as the player finds it. Fully grown Flax will be harvested when damaged by weapons. Area of Effect attacks, such as those of the [[Stagbreaker]], [[Iron Sledge]], or [[Atgeirs]] secondary attack, are very effective for fast harvesting. No Flax is lost, however, these methods do not grant experience towards the [[Farming (Skill)|Farming skill]], and the chance of extra yields will not trigger. As such, using a [[Scythe]] or harvesting by hand have potentially better yield. ==Usage== ===Building=== * {{Item link|Straw}} ===Crafting=== * {{Item link|Linen Thread}} via {{Item link|Spinning Wheel}} ===Farming=== * 2 Flax can be obtained by planting and growing a single Flax using the [[Cultivator]]. ===Taming=== * {{Item link|Lox|size=64px}} {{MaterialsNav}} [[Category:Seeds]] [[Category:Farming]] [[Fr:Lin]] [[ru:Лен]] [[cs:Len]] [[uk:Льон]] [[de:Flachs]]

{{infobox item | title = Barley | image = Barley.png | description = A bundle of barley. | id = Barley | type = Seed | source = [[Fuling Village]]s in the [[Plains]] biome.
[[Abandoned Village]] [[Barrel]]s. | usage = Building, Crafting, Farming, Taming | weight = 0.2 | stack = 100 | teleport = Yes | crop = 2 Barley | grow time = {{duration|4000}}-{{duration|5000}} | cultivated = Yes | radius = 0.5 | biomes = [[Plains]] }} '''Barley''' is a material item found in the [[Plains]] biome, in [[Fuling Village]]s as small patches of cultivated land, and inside of [[Loot chest#Plains Chest|Plains Chest]] found in Fuling Villages, [[Fuling Outpost]]s and [[Fuling Ruin]]s, as well as the barrels inside the granary of [[Abandoned Village]]s in the [[Deep North]]. Barley can only be planted and harvested in the [[Plains]] biome, using a [[Cultivator]]. It takes between 4,000 seconds and 5,000 seconds (between 66 minutes 40 seconds and 83 minutes 20 seconds, or about 2.22-2.78 in-game days) for it to fully grow. Fully grown Barley will drop two Barley when damaged by weapons. AoE attacks, such as those of the [[Stagbreaker]], [[Iron Sledge]] or [[Polearms|Polearms']] secondary attack can be used. No Barley is lost, however, these methods do not grant experience towards the [[Farming (Skill)|Farming skill]], and the chance of extra yields will not trigger. As such, using a [[Scythe]] or harvesting by hand have potentially better yield. ==Usage== ===Building=== *{{Item link|Straw}} ===Crafting=== *{{Item link|Barley Flour}} via {{Item link|Windmill}} *{{Item link|Barley Wine Base: Fire Resistance}} *{{Item link|Yggdrasil Porridge}} ===Farming=== *2 Barley can be obtained by planting and growing a single Barley using the [[Cultivator]]. ===Taming=== *{{Item link|Lox|size=64px}} *{{Item link|Hen|size=40px}} {{MaterialsNav}} [[Category:Materials]] [[fr:Orge]] [[cs:Ječmen]] [[ru:Ячмень]] [[de:Gerste]] [[uk:Ячмінь]]

'''Pine Cones''' are dropped by cutting down [[Pine]]s. They can be planted using the [[Cultivator]] to produce Pine trees. Once planted, the cones take a few in-game days to grow to full size. Tree saplings require a fair amount of space directly around from where they are planted. Without it, they will not grow into trees.

'''Black cores''' are resources obtained from [[Infested Mine]]s that are used to build Mistlands-tier crafting stations.

15 total cores are required to build one of each station.

== Availability ==
* [[Infested Mine]]s in [[Mistlands]].
** Most often found on stands in hidden rooms, occasionally in other rooms.
** 0+ Black cores per mine, usually at least two.
The number per Infested Mine is highly variable, depending on which specific rooms are randomly generated in the mine, and the number of total rooms in the mine (as each mine has between 16 and 96 rooms). Due to this randomness, it is not uncommon to encounter mines with zero cores. Likewise, it is also possible to find over 10 cores in a single mine.
*[[Mörkhalla]]s in [[Deep North]]
** Inside Ancient Chests
